exec.hint.aging.title: How to read AP aging
exec.hint.aging.body: Each bar is the gross positive open AP balance assigned by days from the contractual due date. Select a bar to see its supporting invoices.
exec.hint.aging.basis: Current includes invoices not yet due. The six bars reconcile to AP gross outstanding; supplier credits are shown separately.
exec.hint.cash.title: Near-term cash requirement
exec.hint.cash.body: These are cumulative positive invoice balances due from today through the next 7, 14 and 30 days. Select a figure to inspect its invoices.
exec.hint.cash.basis: The 14-day value includes the 7-day value, and the 30-day value includes both earlier windows.
exec.hint.suppliers.title: Overdue concentration
exec.hint.suppliers.body: Ranks the ten suppliers with the largest positive overdue AED balances for the selected business unit.
exec.hint.suppliers.basis: Select a bar to list that supplier’s overdue invoices. Beneficiary invoices use the effective beneficiary name where available.
exec.hint.ar.title: Why AR aging is unavailable
exec.hint.ar.body: AR transaction headers exist, but the extract does not yet include payment-schedule due dates, receipts, applications and remaining balances.
exec.hint.ar.basis: Transaction totals are intentionally not presented as receivables because doing so could include paid, credited or adjusted transactions.
exec.hint.attention.title: Executive attention list
exec.hint.attention.body: Shows the fifteen largest positive overdue AP balances after the selected business-unit filter.

tpl.title: Report Templates
tpl.subtitle: Word (.docx) and HTML (.j2) PDF layouts — editable without a worker redeploy
tpl.name: File name
tpl.nameHint: Must end in .docx (Word) or .j2 (HTML). This exact name is what a report definition points at.
tpl.inUse: Referenced by report definitions — cannot delete
tpl.guideIntro: Design the layout in Microsoft Word (or edit the .j2 HTML) and put Jinja2 tags where the data goes. Upload it here, then point the report's PDF template at it — the next run uses it on every worker, no redeploy.
tpl.guideStarter: Start from the starter file: download report_starter.docx below, restyle it in Word (fonts, logo, page setup — orientation and margins come from the document), and keep the tags intact.
tpl.guideVarsData: data — the report rows as records: {% for r in data %}{{ r.sector_name }}{% endfor %}
tpl.guideVarsRows: headers / rows — column labels and raw rows for dynamic tables ({%tr%}/{%tc%} loops, see the starter)
tpl.guideVarsMeta: report_name, report_code, meta, generated_at, row_count, params (e.g. {{ params.year }})
tpl.guideVarsSections: sections — for multi-section (MULTI) reports: each has title, headers, rows, data, totals
tpl.guideNote: Word templates convert to PDF via LibreOffice on the workers — stick to standard fonts and tables for faithful output. HTML (.j2) templates render via Chromium exactly like the bundled ones.
